component: HTTP request gate: Host allowlist, Origin == Host, optional API key
modifications: Host check is enabled only for loopback binds or when --allowed-host is given; a non-loopback bind without an allowlist warns and skips it (Splash always checks).
Untrusted Host answers 421 and malformed/duplicate Host 400; cross-origin answers 403 (Splash uses 403 for all).
API key accepted when any single presented Authorization Bearer or x-api-key value matches, instead of requiring exactly one header form.
Key loaded from an owner-only 0600 file (shared with --admin-token-file rules) or a named environment variable; no plain --api-key argument and no implicit environment default.
Admin routes with a configured admin token keep that token as their credential; /health exempt from the key only.
Refusals close the connection before the request body is read; error bodies use the OpenAI or Anthropic shape by route.
